race.description: The Races Wa Podcast With Lochie, Alex & Britt Hcp (66+)
race.comment: SISU SPIRIT (5) flew home to just miss two back before stepping up in trip and finishing 0.3L off the winner most recently. He'll be better again for that effort and things look to work out nicely for him over this track and trip. Can go one better this time around. ROMMEO (2) won two back before being unable to reel them in here last time out. Expecting a forward showing despite the wide alley. MISS VEUVE (13) is ticking along nicely and now gets Pike on board from a good barrier. She drops in weight today on the quick turnaround as she rises in grade. Can put her best foot forward. STARWALKER (3) was too good over 2100m last start and now gets O'Donnell on board replacing the apprentice hoop. Maps for a lovely run in transit and should be in this for a long way. WARRALEA LASS (15) can find the front and be in this for a very long way.
